description: Intent i015 (SNAPSHOT=s04, BRANCH=unclamped-wire-count) concluded. Evidence-backed negative with one unresolved seed-instance: s04 contains the seed vulnerability verbatim (pre-fix code) — drivers/usb/usbip/usbip_common.c:392 `urb->number_of_packets = rpdu->number_of_packets;` stores the peer-supplied ret_submit count unclamped into struct urb, sibling path stub_rx.c:372-377 enforces `number_of_packets < 0 || > packets` (packets = DIV_ROUND_UP(transfer_buffer_length, maxp)) on the cmd_submit direction, and consumer usbip_recv_iso() (usbip_common.c:579-638) computes `int size = np * sizeof(*iso);` -> `kzalloc(size, GFP_KERNEL)` -> `for (i = 0; i < np; i++)` loop; USBIP_MAX_ISO_PACKETS appears nowhere in s04's drivers/usb/usbip. This candidate was classified unresolved, NOT reported, because it is the seed mechanism verbatim and the rules forbid seed names as the finding. Verified clamped entry points: stub_rx.c:372 (cmd_submit count) and usbip_recv_xbuff (size > urb->transfer_buffer_length checked). vhci_rx.c:77 usbip_pack_pdu(RET_SUBMIT) is the unclamped reply entry (unresolved, seed instance). No non-seed finding is reported because the finalize directive stopped the search after the usbip family; the rest of s04's deserialization surface (netlink, ioctl copy_from_user, other protocol parsers) was not swept, which is recorded in limitations. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i015.json (snapshots_checked=["s04"], execution_status=complete, 0 findings, 4 candidates, 3 limitations).
